newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton steady as trade monitors monsoon.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton steady as trade monitors monsoon.

text.p: Cotton prices held steady in a narrow trading range on Thursday, dealers said.
Mill purchases were meagre but limited supplies kept prices steady. The overall volume was dull as major players kept on the sidelines, keeping eye on the progress of monsoon rains.
The first round of rain has been more than satisfactory, particularly in the producing centres of western India, but rainfall was scattered in a southern and central India, a broker said.
"The second round of monsoon has now begun on an encouraging note and producing centres of central and southern India have too started receiving higher rain," he said.

In spot deals, Bengal-deshi was quiet at 995/1,045 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), so was Punjab saw-ginned at 1,800/1,850 rupees per maund. Gujarat Kalyan was steady at 14,000/14,200 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) and wagad cotton at 13,000 rupees per candy.
Long-staple Gujarat Sankar-4 was steady at 17,000/18,000 rupees per candy for the average variety and at 19,500/20,500 rupees for the superior variety.
